div.head: II As 20.2
div.ab: Gif ðonne nelle hwa toridan mid his geferum, gylde cynges oferhyrnysse.
Gif hwa þonne nylle ridan mid his geferan, gilde cynges oferhyrnesse.
Gif þonne nelle hwa ge::dan mid his geferum, gelde cynges oferhiernesse.
Si quis tunc nolit illuc ire cum sociis suis, emendet overhyrnessam regis.
Gif hwa þonne nylle ridan mid his gerefan, gilde cynges oferhyrnesse.
If anyone refuses to ride [on such a mission] with his companions, he shall pay the fine for insubordination to the king.
If, however, anyone will not ride with his fellows, he is to pay the fine for disobedience to the king.
Wenn aber einer [dorthin] mit seinen Genossen nicht mitziehen will, zahle er [Busse für] Ungehorsam gegen den König.
But if anyone will not ride [there] with his companions, let him pay [the fine for] disobedience to the king.
